text:
请对一份中文比赛路演 PPT 做逐页视觉验收（用户验收标准：能直接上台讲，版式与可读性过关）。

背景：13.333×7.5 英寸 16:9，字体 MiSans / Consolas，暖纸色 #F7F6F1 底 + 墨黑 + 朱红强调；这是 openvela 大赛的骑行码表产品路演，页面上有真实 240×320 设备截图（深色边框里的竖屏）。

逐页 PNG（已按 150dpi 渲染，均在同一目录）：
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-01.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-02.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-03.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-04.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-05.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-06.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-07.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-08.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-09.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-10.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-11.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-12.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-13.png
/tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-14.png

请只依据这些 PNG 判断，不要读 pptx 源码。重点检查：
1) 文字是否溢出/被裁切/压到别的元素/离边太近；
2) 视觉焦点是否清楚，版面是否失衡或有大块空洞；
3) 对齐、间距、字号层级是否像人工设计（不是模板味）；
4) 设备截图边框/比例是否正常，图片是否被拉伸；
5) 深色页（1、11、14）的文字对比度是否足够；
6) 中文标点、断行是否别扭（如行首标点、孤字）。
每页给一行 JSON：{"page":N,"verdict":"pass|fail","issues":["具体问题 + 位置"],"fix":"一句可执行的修法"}。issues 必须具体到元素与位置；没有问题的页也要给 pass。最后给一句总体判断（能否直接上台）。

thinking:
Let me start by reading the page images one by one and judging each. I have 14 pages. Let me read them in batches, but the instruction says "Read your page images one by one, writing each page's verdict immediately after reading it." I can read multiple in parallel though — but to follow workflow, I'll read them one by one or in small batches. Actually the workflow says read one by one and write verdict immediately after reading. Let me read a few at a time to be efficient but still write verdicts in order.

Let me begin.

Slide 1: Dark page (near black). Title "Helm One" big white — good contrast. Subtitle white — good. Small gray text "车上独立工作：没手机也能记录、离线导航、沿轨迹返航。" — gray on dark, somewhat lower contrast but readable. Top kicker "2026 首届 openvela AI 硬件开发者大赛 · 图形" in gray — readable. Device screenshot on right: portrait device with dark border, gauge 20.5 km/h, HR 128 bpm, stats. Aspect ratio looks normal (portrait 240x320 → appears ~340x510 roughly 2:3, correct). Caption "P02 · 表盘页 20.5 km/h" below. Footer "全开源 · Apache-2.0" and "独立开发 · 2026". Contrast: the gray caption text is a bit dim but acceptable. Layout balanced: left text, right device. Pass.

Note "openvela" vs dispatch says "openvela" — fine.

Slide 1 pass. Next slide 2.

Slide 2: Light page. Left column with 3 numbered items (01 反光, 02 手套, 03 没网), right column with big statement "码表的第一性原理：抬头 0.5 秒，看清一个数。" in black + red. Clean hierarchy. Alignment: left items aligned, numbers red. Right column: text baseline roughly aligned with the list. There's some empty space bottom-left below item 03 and below right quote, but acceptable. Bottom-right page number "02 / 14". No overflow. Chinese punctuation looks fine. Line breaks: "不 / 是分辨率。" — breaks "不是" across lines which is normal for CJK. Pass.

Slide 3: Left spec list with big values (2.4", 2颗, 3km, 2核) and descriptions, right device screenshot P01 map page with caption and below "240×320 · 半透半反 · 无触摸". Device ratio looks correct portrait. Map content on device: status bar 22:12, map, card with time, "长按按键 开始骑行" button. Looks fine. One thing: the label says "P01 · 地图首页" and the device shows 22:12. Fine.

Minor: there's "全国矢量图按 3 km 切块存 SD ，骑到哪加载哪。" — space before comma "SD ，" slight awkward spacing but minor. Also "应用核跑界面； 144 / 240 MHz" spacing. These are small typographic spacing issues, not egregious. Layout balanced. Pass.
Slide 4: Left: three stacked cards (感知/计算/呈现) connected by small vertical lines. Right: 5 decision entries with rules between. Layout clean, no overflow. Text spacing OK. Pass.

Slide 5: Layered stack (APP/LINK/HELM/BSP/OS/SoC) with HELM row highlighted light green, OS row dark. Right column stats 19/6/A20. Clean. One observation: the OS dark bar — text "openvela" white on dark, "NuttX 内核 · VFS / LittleFS · 蓝牙栈 · USB" grayish on dark — readable. The label "OS" dark gray on dark bar — low contrast but it's a small tag; it's dimmer than others (others red). Could be intentional. Row under: SoC row. Fine.

Check the stack alignment: the bars are left-aligned consistent width. Right stats aligned. Pass.

Slide 6 has a clear problem: the fourth device screenshot (P01 首页) overlaps the right column text. "图形栈" heading is partially covered by the device screenshot ("图形栈" → shows "图形栈" with the 栈 partially cut by device edge; and "LVGL 9.5 + EPIC GPU..." line starts under/behind the device; also "信息架构" heading overlaps the device ("信息架构" shows partially behind device corner: "信息架构" appears as "信...架构" with parts hidden); and "7 个主页面 · 28 个菜单屏 · 8 条通知收件箱" — the "7" is hidden behind the device, showing "? 个主页面". The device screenshot clearly overlaps the text block on the right side. This is a fail: Design — module overlap.

Also the horizontal rule lines of the right column run behind/into the device image area — the top rule at y~230 extends from x~1010 leftwards to under the device? Actually the rule spans from x~1010 to 1990 and the device occupies until ~1080. The device overlaps the rules too.

So slide 6: fail. Issue: P01 首页 device screenshot overlaps right column text (图形栈/信息架构 headings and body lines partially hidden). Fix: shrink/move device row left or start right column further right.

Slide 7: Performance bar chart, 4 rows with before/after bars, values and red percentage deltas. Bars: row1 bar filled ~78% of track (27.2→21.9 = -19.5%), row2 61→43.7 (-28.4%), row3 2.88→1.94 (-32.6%), row4 195→17 (-91%) small fill dark green. Bars normalized to before value — the fill fractions: row1 21.9/27.2 = 0.805 ≈ 78% ✓. Row2 43.7/61 = 0.716 ≈ 71% ✓. Row3 1.94/2.88 = 0.674 ≈ 67% ✓. Row4 17/195 = 0.087 ≈ 8.7% ✓. Consistent. Good.

Alignment: bars all start at x~530, tracks end ~1240. Values right of bars. Deltas right-aligned. Footnotes at bottom. Clean. One tiny thing: "地图瓦片光栅化" bar track appears slightly wider? Row1 track ends at ~1240 same. OK.

Pass.

Slide 8: Left is a zoomed map screenshot (appears to be enlarged crop of the 240x320 screen — status bar 22:12 etc.). Ratio: it's rendered roughly square-ish (760x690?) — hmm, actually the screenshot shows a map page. The device screenshot P04 is 240x320 portrait = 3:4 ratio. The image shown here: width ~680px, height ~690px → roughly square, not 3:4. Wait let me measure: image spans x≈110..790 (680 wide), y≈280..975 (695 tall). That's about 0.98 aspect — nearly square, not 0.75 (3:4). Hmm, but is it a crop (scaled up, cropped) rather than the full screen? The caption says "P04 · 地图页（真机矢量底图）". The status bar is at top and bottom shows partial tiles cut off at bottom edge — the bottom row shows tile tops cut. It looks like the image is cropped bottom (the map content ends abruptly at the bottom border without the bottom status area). Actually the original P04 device screenshot on slide 3 shows map filling the top 2/3 and a card at bottom. Here we see status bar at top and map filling all the way down with tile edges cut at bottom — suggesting a crop of the map area only, displayed at ~square.

Is this "destructive cropping"? It seems intentional: an enlarged view of the map raster. The bottom edge shows the tiles cut mid-way, which looks like a crop artifact. Hmm. The bottom of the image shows partial map tiles with a white strip cut — that reads like the screenshot is cropped at bottom. But it could also be the actual full-screen rendering where the bottom part is tiles... On slide 3's P01 device, the map fills the top portion and there's a bottom card. On P04 (map page), the full screen would be map + status bar. The crop shows status bar at top, map below, cut at bottom. If the source is 240x320 with status bar ~24px, map area 240x296 → aspect 0.81. Displayed at ~680x695 ≈ 0.98. Not matching.

Let me zoom into the image to check whether the bottom is cut off or if there's a UI element. I'll crop the region with a tool? I shouldn't use re-rendering, but reading portions of the image is allowed. I can use Bash with ImageMagick to crop... wait, "edit nothing; never write into the deliverable or the workspace" — cropping to a temp file for inspection is a read-like operation but writes a file. The workflow says re-rendering forbidden; cropping for inspection is borderline. I could just re-read the image with the Read tool — it shows the whole image again. I can look carefully at the rendered image as given.

Looking again at the image: bottom edge around y≈970: there are map tiles that get cut, and three white rounded shapes at the very bottom (looks like tops of rounded rectangles cut off). That suggests the screenshot bottom is cropped mid-content. The caption below says P04 地图页（真机矢量底图）. If it's an intentional "zoom-in" detail crop, cutting mid-tile is acceptable as a stylized detail? For a map close-up, cutting tiles is natural (maps are continuous). But the white rounded shapes cut at bottom look like UI elements cut off — that indicates destructive cropping of UI.

Hmm, but wait — maybe this is not a crop; maybe the rendered map page fills the screen 240x320 and this presentation enlarged it while keeping aspect: 240x320 = 0.75. Displayed 680/695=0.978. Not 0.75. So either stretched or cropped. If cropped from 3:4 to ~1:1, about 23% of height removed — likely the bottom UI (nav bar or card). The bottom shows cut rounded white shapes → UI cut. This is a visual issue: image cropped, cutting off bottom UI elements, and displayed aspect doesn't match source 3:4.

Actually, let me reconsider: maybe the bottom three white shapes are the tops of bottom navigation pills which are genuinely at the bottom edge of the screen and the crop keeps them partially — sloppy.

I'll flag slide 8 as fail with Visual issue: enlarged P04 screenshot cropped/stretched — aspect not 3:4, bottom UI elements cut mid-shape.

Hmm, but is it possibly a deliberate zoom-in of just the map raster ("真机矢量底图" = real-device vector base map), i.e., they intend to show the map tiles detail, not the full screen? The caption "P04 · 地图页（真机矢量底图）" suggests showing the map page. The status bar is included at top, so it's meant to be the full screen. If full screen, aspect must be 3:4; it isn't. Also bottom UI cut. So flag it.

Also check right column: 7.8 GB / 5,925 块 / 13 km / 50–150 ms with descriptions right-aligned column. Fine. Footnotes at bottom. OK.

Slide 8: fail (Visual: screenshot aspect/crop).

Wait — measure more carefully. The map image: left edge x≈110, right edge x≈790. Top y≈280, bottom y≈975. 680 x 695. Ratio 0.978. Yeah, near-square.

Actually, maybe I should crop the image to inspect the bottom edge precisely. The rules say I review only; using bash to crop a temp copy for closer inspection doesn't modify the deliverable. It's a read-only inspection aid. I think it's acceptable to create a temp crop in /tmp (not the workspace... /tmp is fine, and "never write into the deliverable or the workspace" — /tmp crops are not the deliverable). But also "re-rendering of any kind is forbidden" — cropping an existing render is not re-rendering. I'll do one crop to verify slide 8 bottom edge, and later slide details as needed. Actually, let me be careful about efficiency. I'll crop slide-08 bottom region.

input: {"command": "cd /tmp && mkdir -p review_crops && magick /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-08.png -crop 800x200+90+820 +repage /tmp/review_crops/s08_bottom.png 2>/dev/null || convert /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-08.png -crop 800x200+90+820 +repage /tmp/review_crops/s08_bottom.png; identify /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-08.png", "description": "Crop bottom region of slide 8 render for closer inspection"}

thinking:
Confirmed: the bottom edge of the map screenshot cuts through map tiles and there are partial white rounded shapes (cut-off UI elements) at the very bottom. The screenshot is cropped — bottom content sliced mid-element. Given the source is a 240x320 screen (3:4), displaying it near-square means it's cropped, not stretched. The cut-off white pills at bottom look like sliced UI (possibly the bottom card from P04 screen). This is a visible crop artifact at the bottom edge of the enlarged screenshot.

Severity: it reads like a detail/zoom shot of the map; but the sliced rounded rectangles at the bottom edge do look unfinished. I'll report as fail with Visual category: bottom edge slices through UI elements (three white rounded shapes cut in half) — destructive cropping of the device screenshot.

Hmm, one issue one entry. Category Visual (inside an image). Fix: show the full 240x320 frame (keep 3:4) or crop to map area only excluding the sliced UI row.

Actually wait — could those white rounded shapes be part of the map itself (e.g., buildings rendered as rounded rects)? On the P01 map (slide 3), the bottom card is a white rounded card. In P04 地图页 maybe there's a bottom bar of buttons. The shapes look like three side-by-side rounded rectangles, evenly spaced — resembling a bottom tab bar with 3 buttons. Cut in half. Yes, sliced UI.

Proceed to slide 9.

Slide 9: 5-step flow with numbered circles connected by lines, step 4 highlighted red. Bottom has a rule and a takeaway statement. Middle band between the step descriptions (ending ~y530) and the bottom rule (~y815) is empty — a large blank horizontal band (~280px tall at 2000px width). Is that "big empty hole"? The layout: title top, flow middle-upper, then a large gap, then bottom takeaway. The gap is noticeable — roughly 25% of slide height empty in the middle. Hmm. Presentation slides often have breathing room; but here the visual center sits high with an empty band between flow and takeaway. It's borderline. The step descriptions end around y=530, rule at y=815. That's a ~285px gap on a 1125px tall render — about 25%. For a 16:9 slide, that's a visible empty band but the bottom takeaway anchors the page. It reads as intentional whitespace? The dispatch says watch "版面失衡或有大块空洞". This middle gap is fairly large. But the composition: top-heavy flow + bottom statement. I'd say it's acceptable-ish but noticeable. Let me consider: content occupies top 47% and bottom 25%; middle 25% empty. Actually that whitespace band reads intentional (separating flow from takeaway). Hmm.

I lean pass with no issue — whitespace is a design choice; the page still reads balanced horizontally. But 25% contiguous empty band... On other slides similar gaps exist? Slide 2 had bottom-left whitespace too. For stage presentation, one glance: title, 5 steps, takeaway. Fine. Pass.

Check text: "蓝牙写 import/ ，或 USB MTP 拷入" — "import/" odd trailing slash but that's content (command name). Fine. Pass.
Slide 10: Left big "144 / 240 MHz · 两档 DVFS" + 4 state chips (骑行 dark, 静止, 熄屏, 关机). Right list of 5 items with rules. Clean, consistent. No overflow. Pass.

Slide 11: Dark page. Big red "0" on left with "次看门狗复位" white below, gray "单次开机 31,965 s（8.9 h）" — the gray small text on dark: moderately low contrast but readable. Right: 3 blocks with white headings and gray body. Body text is light gray on near-black — readable at presentation distance? The body is fairly light gray (#aaa-ish), acceptable. Kicker "10 — 可靠性" gray on dark — dim but small. Footer source line dim gray — fine for a footnote.

Title "8.9 小时，0 次看门狗" white bold — good.

One concern: title says "8.9 小时，0 次看门狗" — content claims. Fine.

Contrast check for the dim texts: kicker "10 — 可靠性" appears mid-gray; on dark bg could be borderline but it's a kicker, minor. The left label "次看门狗复位" white bold ok. I'd pass contrast overall. Layout balanced: big 0 left, list right. Pass.
Slide 12: 5 stats row + two columns (开源 / 可复现). Clean, consistent. Bottom 20% empty but fine. Pass.
Slide 13: Left statement block, right 5 numbered rows. Clean. Pass.

Slide 14: Dark closing page. Big white title "让 openvela 从手腕，走到车把。" — good contrast. Sub "Helm One · 开源骑行码表 · Apache-2.0" gray-white — okay. Device on right: boot screen (Helm One logo, 骑行记录 · 已检查, progress bar), caption "Helm One · 开机启动". Device frame normal portrait ratio. Bottom small gray "源码 / 板级 / App / 地图工具链 · 全部随作品提交" — dim but small footer, acceptable. Page "14 / 14" bottom right dim.

Contrast: caption "Helm One · 开机启动" gray on dark — moderate; readable. Pass.

Now, back to slide 6 — verify the overlap carefully. The 4th device (P01 首页) right edge ~x1080; right column starts x~1010. "图形栈" heading at x~1010 — the device covers part of it. From the render: "图形栈" appears with left part behind the device edge — I saw "图形栈" text partially hidden: it rendered as "图形栈" but with the device overlapping — evidence: the "栈" character partially occluded by device bezel; "LVGL 9.5..." line begins behind device ("LVGL" shows as "LVGL" partially cut: I saw "LVGL 9.5 + EPIC GPU" but the first characters are partially covered — in the render it showed "LVGL 9.5" starting under the device edge, and "7 个主页面" showed the "7" hidden behind device corner. Also the two horizontal rules of the right column pass behind the device.

Let me crop slide 6 to confirm precisely.

input: {"command": "convert /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-06.png -crop 700x560+900+220 +repage /tmp/review_crops/s06_overlap.png && identify /tmp/review_crops/s06_overlap.png", "description": "Crop overlap region of slide 6 for closer inspection"}

thinking:
Confirmed on slide 6: the 4th device screenshot (P01 首页) overlaps the right column:
- "图形栈" heading: the "栈" character partially covered by device bezel (shows "图形栈" with 栈 clipped).
- "LVGL 9.5 + EPIC GPU..." — "LVGL" first characters partially behind device (shows "LVG̲L" with "L" partially occluded).
- "信息架构" heading — "信" partially behind device edge (shows "信息架构" with left edge occluded... in the crop it shows "信息架构" but "信" touches the device).
- "7 个主页面 · 28 个菜单屏 · 8 条通知收件箱" — the "7" is fully hidden behind the device, showing "? 个主页面" — actually in crop I see the orange "7" partially visible behind device corner.
- Horizontal rules of right column pass behind/into the device.
- Caption "P01 首页" sits close to the rule; fine.

Clear fail for slide 6.

Now double-check slide 8's bottom crop interpretation: the white rounded shapes cut at bottom. Also check top-left of the map screenshot: status bar present. The overall aspect near-square vs 3:4 source. Since the caption says "真机矢量底图" (real-device vector base map), the crop may be intentional to show the map. But the sliced white shapes at the bottom edge are cut UI elements — that reads as unfinished cropping. I'll report it.

Let me also double check slide 2's right column and any text near edges, and slide 1's small gray text contrast. Slide 1: "车上独立工作：..." gray on dark (#8a8a85-ish on #1a1a17) — contrast maybe ~4-5:1 at small size; acceptable-ish at presentation? It's a tertiary line; fine. The bottom "全开源 · Apache-2.0" white-ish, fine. Top kicker gray but readable.

Also slide 5 OS row: label "OS" dark gray on near-black bar — it's dim (I saw "OS" in dark gray). Other labels (APP, LINK, HELM, BSP, SoC) are red. The OS one being dark-on-dark is low contrast. Let me crop to verify.

input: {"command": "convert /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-05.png -crop 1100x240+100+730 +repage /tmp/review_crops/s05_osrow.png", "description": "Crop OS row of slide 5 for contrast check"}

thinking:
Slide 5 OS row: label "OS" is dark gray on near-black bar — low contrast (barely visible compared to red labels on other rows). Also notice the dark OS bar: there's a subtle darker sub-strip at its bottom-left (the bar has a slightly different shade below around y~95 in crop — looks like the bar has an offset shadow/second rectangle visible at bottom edge, left portion). In the crop I see the black bar and below-left a slightly lighter dark strip extending to about x~470, then background. Hmm, that could be a stacked shadow or a misaligned second bar. Look: the black bar occupies y 8..95; from y 95..100 there's a darker strip continuing left of x~470. It looks like a shadow rectangle offset below, partially visible only on the left half. Slightly odd but subtle. Actually it might be an intentional offset "shadow" accent but it stops mid-way, which reads as an artifact. Let me look at full slide again... In the full slide-05 view, below the OS bar there's a subtle dark line under the left half of the bar. This looks like a dropped-shadow rectangle that doesn't span the full width. Hmm, could also be the SoC row's top edge? No, SoC row starts lower.

Severity: minor. The "OS" label contrast is the more concrete issue: dark gray (#3a3a35?) on black bar — nearly invisible; every other row's tag is red. Is that a deliberate design choice (de-emphasized tag on the dark row)? Possibly, but a nearly invisible label reads as a defect at presentation distance? At one glance, you don't need to read "OS" — the row content is legible (white "openvela", light gray description "NuttX 内核 · VFS / LittleFS · 蓝牙栈 · USB" — the description text is mid-gray on black: readable). The tag being almost invisible: I'd flag as a minor contrast issue. But per rules: report only concrete problems; one glance readability: description gray on black is okay.

Let me sample pixel colors to be objective about the "OS" label contrast and the description text.

input: {"command": "convert /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-05.png -crop 1x1+152+776 -format '%[pixel:p{0,0}]' info: ; echo; convert /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-05.png -crop 1x1+560+776 -format '%[pixel:p{0,0}]' info:; echo; convert /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-05.png -crop 1x1+700+770 -format '%[pixel:p{0,0}]' info:", "description": "Sample pixel colors of OS label, bar background, description text on slide 5"}

thinking: Sample points: at (152,776) I sampled maybe background of bar (30,37,32). Description text pixel (560,776) = (157,167,158) light gray — that's the text color vs bar bg (~ (23,29,25)): contrast decent (~7:1). The "OS" label: I sampled wrong coordinate. The label "OS" is at approximately x=140..170, y=770-785 in the full render? From the crop (offset +100+730), "OS" appeared at crop coords (~35..60, ~38..50) → full coords (135..160, 768..780). Let me sample a pixel on the "O" glyph stroke. Glyph strokes are thin; single-pixel sampling may hit background. Use ImageMagick to get histogram of small region.

input: {"command": "convert /tmp/ppt_build/render/slide-05.png -crop 40x20+133+766 +repage -colors 5 -format %c histogram:info:-", "description": "Get dominant colors of OS label region on slide 5"}

thinking:
The "OS" label glyph color is around #8E9A91 (with anti-aliasing down to #59635B) on background #181E1A. Contrast ratio: relative luminance of #8E9A91 ≈ let's compute roughly: R=0.556,G=0.606,B=0.569 → linearized ≈ (0.27,0.325,0.283); L ≈ 0.2126*0.27+0.7152*0.325+0.0722*0.283 ≈ 0.0574+0.2324+0.0204=0.310. Background #181E1A: ≈ (0.094,0.118,0.102) srgb → linear ≈ (0.0088,0.0132,0.0104) → L≈0.0021+0.0094+0.0008=0.0123. Ratio = (0.310+0.05)/(0.0123+0.05) = 0.360/0.0623 ≈ 5.8:1. That's actually fine for small text (WCAG AA 4.5:1). So the "OS" tag gray is acceptable — dimmer than red siblings but legible. Not a defect. It's likely a deliberate muted tag. OK, slide 5 passes.

Now re-examine slide 2 for anything: bottom-left whitespace below "03 没网" description and right column below "其余的事，交给手机。" — the right column ends at y~790, left ends ~y900; bottom third mostly empty but even. Acceptable.

Slide 9: the middle gap. Let me reconsider: content flow ends y~530; bottom rule at y~815; gap ≈ 285px of 1125 ≈ 25%. Hmm. Both slide 2 and 9 have generous whitespace, consistent with the deck's airy style (many slides have large bottom margins, e.g., slide 12 bottom ~25% empty). The deck style is consistent airy; I'll not fail for that alone.

Slide 3 minor spacing "SD ，" — full-width comma preceded by space; trivial, not failing. Also slide 3: "切块存 SD ，骑到哪加载哪" fine.

Slide 6 also check: 4 device screenshots in a row at top — the 4th overlaps right column; also check the 3rd (P07 菜单) bottom: it shows "系统" label and a cut-off row "屏..." at bottom edge — device screens show partial list items cut by screen edge which is normal for a scrolling menu (真实 UI). That's the actual device rendering; acceptable.

Also slide 6: left bottom status bar zoom strip: 19:40 with icons and battery — fine, caption "状态栏五态：正常 / 暂停 / 低电 / 外设全断 / 未记录" and "同一份 LVGL 源码，PC 模拟器逐页渲染。" Fine.

Now check slide 6's first device P05 仪表台: right edge of first device at x~330; second starts x~350. The 4th device right edge x~1085 vs right column x~1010. Confirmed overlap.

Also check slide 6 heading rules: The right column top rule starts at x~1010 and extends right; it passes behind the 4th device. Yes.
